definitions.explanation: A traffic incident where a driver strikes a person or vehicle and flees the scene without stopping to help or identify themselves.

examples.japanese: ひき{逃|に}げ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
ひき{逃|に}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、ひき{逃|に}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to witness information, the hit-and-run vehicle was identified.

notes:
FORMS:
ひき (⟦{轢|ひ}き→轢く：27775_hiku⟧, from ⟦{轢|ひ}く→轢く：27775_hiku⟧ "to run over") + ⟦{逃|に}げ→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (from ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ "to flee"). Literally "run over and flee."

LEGAL CONTEXT:
ひき{逃|に}げ is a serious crime in Japan. Penalties are more severe than for accidents where the driver remains at the scene. It is also called {救護|きゅうご}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧ (failure to fulfill the duty to assist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひき{逃|に}げ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: hit-and-run accident
- ひき{逃|に}げ{犯|はん}: hit-and-run offender
- ひき{逃|に}げにあう: to be the victim of a hit-and-run
